hubIntro: Madison is a Nashville community about eight miles north of downtown, running from Briley Parkway to the Hendersonville line and from Dickerson Pike to the Cumberland River. Gallatin Pike is its main street, with Downtown Madison and the Rivergate area as its two centers, and the Madison Station post office dates the community back to 1857.

Triple Oak Services is based in Nashville and handles tree removal, tree trimming and pruning, stump grinding, storm damage cleanup and land clearing in Madison. This page covers what tree work in Madison tends to involve, how its mid-century neighborhoods and mature shade trees shape the work, and what to know before you hire a crew. Every job starts with a free, no-obligation estimate.

sections.h2: Post-war neighborhoods with sixty-year-old shade trees
paragraphs: Much of Madison was built in the decades after World War II, with ranch houses and split-levels set on generous front and back yards. The shade trees planted when those neighborhoods were new have now had sixty-plus years to grow, and they have often outgrown the lots they were planted on. Silver maples, sweetgums, tulip poplars and oaks that were small saplings in the 1960s now tower over rooflines, driveways, fences and service lines.

Typical calls include trees whose roots are lifting driveways and cracking sidewalks, limbs growing over roofs and carports, and big trees at the end of their life that are dead or declining at the top. Fast-growing species like silver maple and sweetgum tend to be brittle as they age, and a large limb can come down in an ordinary storm. We take trees down in sections where there is no room to drop them and haul the debris away.

sections.h2: Gallatin Pike, Rivergate, Madison Station and the commercial strips
paragraphs: Gallatin Pike carries most of Madison's commercial traffic, with Rivergate to the north and the historic Madison Station and Amqui Station area closer to the heart of the community. Trees along parking lots, strip centers and the edges of apartment complexes need maintenance too, from clearing limbs off signs and lighting to removing hazardous trees near parked cars and entrances. Property managers often need a fast, clean removal with minimal disruption, and we work with that.

Residential streets off the Pike have small lots, overhead lines and limited access, so work here is often close-quarters. We look at lines, fences and what is underneath the tree before we explain the plan and give a price.

sections.h2: The Cumberland River, parks and creek bottoms
paragraphs: Madison sits along the Cumberland River valley, and parks such as Peeler Park and Cedar Hill Park have mature trees along trails and low ground. Wet soil, creek bottoms and occasional flooding can weaken root systems over time, and trees leaning toward the water, trees with exposed roots and trees with sudden dieback in the crown are the ones we are most often asked to look at.

Spring thunderstorms and straight-line winds are the main cause of storm damage across Madison. Watch for a lean that is getting worse, cracks in the trunk or where a big limb meets it, mushrooms or conks around the base, soil heaving on one side and large dead branches high in the crown. Any of them is a reason to have the tree inspected before the next storm.

sections.h2: Before you remove a tree in Madison
paragraphs: Madison is part of Metro Nashville, so Metro's rules apply. Trees on public property, including street trees and park trees, are protected, and requirements for commercial and multifamily properties differ from those for single-family yards. Because rules have changed over the years and can change again, check with Metro Codes or the Metro Urban Forester before removing a large tree, and check with your HOA if you have one.

Look up before work begins. Trees touching or close to power lines, including those served by Nashville Electric Service, should be handled by the utility or a qualified line-clearance crew, and anyone in danger should call 911. If stump grinding or digging is involved, call Tennessee 811 so buried utilities are marked.

We are a locally owned, licensed and insured company based in Nashville. For Madison jobs we give a free estimate, explain how the tree will come down and what the price includes, remove it safely and haul the debris away. Stump grinding can be added on the same visit, and storm damage and emergency removal are available when a tree is already down. If trimming will do the job, we will tell you.

tree-trimming-pruning.title: Tree Trimming & Pruning in Madison, TN | Triple Oak Services
tree-trimming-pruning.description: Tree trimming and pruning in Madison, TN: dead limb removal, crown thinning, clearance from roofs and lines, storm-risk reduction. Licensed, insured. Call 615-561-0472.
paragraphs: Mature shade trees are one of Madison's best features, and regular pruning keeps them safe. Removing dead wood, thinning heavy crowns and shortening overextended limbs lowers the chance of a branch failing over a roof, car or carport, which matters with brittle species like silver maple and sweetgum.

Common trimming calls include limbs over roofs and gutters, branches rubbing siding, trees crowding service lines and canopies that shade out a yard. On commercial properties, clearing limbs off signs, lighting and entrances is routine.
We do not top trees. We explain what will be removed and why before any cutting begins.

faq.q: Can trimming save an old maple or sweetgum?
faq.a: Often. Removing dead wood and reducing weight on long limbs can keep a healthy tree safe. We tell you honestly when removal is the better choice.

faq.q: Can you trim trees near power lines?
faq.a: Limbs near power lines should be handled by the utility or a qualified line-clearance crew. We can trim around your house and property away from the lines.

stump-grinding.title: Stump Grinding in Madison, TN | Triple Oak Services
stump-grinding.description: Stump grinding in Madison, TN: stumps ground below grade, root flare removal and cleanup so your yard is ready to use. Free estimates. Call 615-561-0472.
paragraphs: A stump left after a removal makes mowing, fencing and landscaping harder. We grind stumps below grade in Madison so the spot can be filled, seeded or sodded, from a small stump on a tight lot off Gallatin Pike to a large maple stump with spreading roots in a post-war yard.

Old shade trees often leave behind big, wide root flares, and lots in older neighborhoods can have buried lines and old foundations nearby. The job gets a look first. Call Tennessee 811 before digging or grinding so buried utilities are marked, and we will go over access, depth and cleanup during the estimate.
Stump grinding pairs well with removal. Ask us to grind the stump on the same visit.

faq.q: Can you grind big root flares?
faq.a: Yes. Large old stumps often have wide roots at the surface, and we grind them below grade.

faq.q: Can the machine get into a tight backyard?
faq.a: Often, yes. Access is one of the first things we check during the estimate.

paragraphs: Madison's old shade trees take a lot of punishment in storms. Brittle species lose big limbs onto roofs, cars and carports, and whole trees come down across streets and driveways, particularly near the Cumberland River valley where soil can be wet.

If a tree is down, make everyone safe first. If a power line is involved or anyone is in danger, call 911 and Nashville Electric Service, then call us. We provide storm damage and emergency tree removal, including same-day emergency removal where scheduling allows, and we clear trees and limbs from roofs, yards and driveways.
After a storm, check the trees that stayed standing for cracks, loosened soil and hanging branches, and have them looked at before the next one.

A typical job removes brush and undergrowth, takes out the trees in the way, grinds stumps if needed and leaves a clean, usable site. We walk the property first so we know what stays and what goes, and we give you a clear price before work begins.
If clearing is part of a development, check with Metro Nashville about permits and tree-protection requirements. We clear to the lines you mark.

faq.q: Do you clear overgrown vacant lots?

faq.q: Do I need approval before clearing land?
